export const LABELS: any = {
  de,
  en,
  tr: de,
  ar: de,
  fa: de,
  prs: de,
  ps: de,
  ckb: de,
  ku: de,
};
export function label(language: string | null | undefined, key: string) {
  const l = language && LABELS[language] ? language : "de";
  return LABELS[l]?.[key] || de[key as keyof typeof de] || key;
}
